objective: Audit and design the housing market demand and demographic segmentation. Evaluate how housing is generated over time and how demand is calculated based on population age and wealth tiers. Extend real_estate_market.rs with age-tier and wealth-tier segmented demand. Ensure strict compatibility between residential buildings and the spatial parcel system. Model the direct impact of housing quality on citizen happiness and quality of life.
constraints: RAM protection: cargo check and cargo clippy only
Rule 1: All housing transactions (rent, sale) must have strict counterparty; no fiat creation
Rule 2: Housing demand thresholds must scale by average_wage and income tiers, not flat rates
Rule 3: Physical BOM for residential buildings must be static; financial costs from market prices
Rule 5: Housing allocation must use market clearing or pro-rata by income tier, not arbitrary splits
Rule 9: Parcel-based housing must use cadastre index lookups to avoid double mutable borrows
Rule 13: Residential building types must have distinct MethodSlots with physically different BOMs
Rule 14: Extend existing society/housing.rs and real_estate_market.rs; do not create parallel housing infrastructure
Rule 15: Housing demand must scale by population count, age distribution, and wealth tier distribution
Rule 17: Housing quality and demand data must be visible in UI snapshots
Rule 20: Housing inventory must have hard limits with overflow (waitlist) behavior
Rule 22: Do not modify fertilizer, military, sports, or environment modules. Do NOT implement utility systems or cooperative lifecycles.
Rule 23: Surgically append to society/geography.rs and registries; do not overwrite existing housing structs
SCOPE LIMIT: This blueprint ONLY covers real estate market demand, demographic segmentation, parcel linkage, and happiness impact.
api_contracts: state/src/society/real_estate_market.rs — Extend housing demand calculation with age-tier and wealth-tier segmentation
state/src/society/housing.rs — Add HousingQuality struct tracking quality metrics per residential building
state/src/registries/enums.rs — Add BuildingType variants for residential building types if not present
state/src/economy/labor/labor.rs — Extend happiness/quality_of_life calculation with housing quality
completion_criteria: Housing demand calculated from population age and wealth tiers. Real estate market clearing uses segmented demand. Residential buildings linked to parcel system. Housing quality impacts citizen happiness. UI snapshots expose housing demand and quality data. M0 conservation maintained. Iron CI/CD green.
harmonization_notes: v5 resubmission. No content changes from v4 — rejected only for re-harmonization. Updated roadmap reference to roadmap-005. HOUSING SPLIT PART 1 of 3.
